Class Player

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am23.model.player.Player
public class Player extends Object
Represents a player participating in the match. Owns the player's resources (food, prestige points), the Tribe of collected cards and the Totem used to mark board areas.

      public Player(String id, String nickname, int food, int prestigePoints, Totem totem)
      Builds a new player.
      Parameters:
      id - unique identifier of the player
      nickname - display nickname
      food - starting food reserve (must be non negative)
      prestigePoints - starting prestige points
      totem - the totem assigned to the player
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if food is negative
